segments.text: One teammate is drowning in tasks. Another has hours to spare. You only notice when someone burns out.
Employetics watches your team every day, and flags who is heading for burnout.
One click gives a fairer split. In this demo, the most overloaded teammate drops from 115 percent to 88 percent capacity.
A balanced team. Before burnout, not after.
Employetics. Predict burnout. Keep your people.
